--- title: "Explore" vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Explore} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- Interactive exemplars for the three chart families the project uses: **time series**, **2D**, and **3D**. Each reads a pipeline target, so the input → chart lineage is explicit. The default stack is R htmlwidgets (`plotly`, `ggiraph`); Observable JS is reserved for bespoke explorables (a later addition). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} picks <- tar_read(picks) |> filter(year >= 2013, !is.na(height), !is.na(weight), !is.na(overall)) ``` ::: ## Time series — drafts per year ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_drafts_by_season(tar_read(model_table)) ``` ::: {#fig-timeseries .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 2D — draft capital vs. physicals (hover for player) Each point is a drafted player; hover for the name. Color encodes draft round. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_scatter_2d( dplyr::slice_sample(picks, n = min(1500, nrow(picks))), x = weight, y = height, tooltip = name, color = round ) ``` ::: {#fig-2d .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 3D — height × weight × overall pick ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_scatter_3d(picks, x = "height", y = "weight", z = "overall", color = "round") ``` ::: {#fig-3d .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Branding — team logos The `teams` dimension carries each program's logo and colors, joined by school name via `link_team_meta()` and kept off the model path (display only, decision 0008). Two rendering paths: a `reactable` table with logo thumbnails and color swatches, and a `ggiraph` bar filled with each team's brand color that shows its logo on hover. ::: {#tbl-team-logos .cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_team_logos(tar_read(teams)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_drafts_by_team(tar_read(model_table), tar_read(teams)) ``` ::: {#fig-drafts-by-team .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.callout-tip} These are templates, not findings — they demonstrate the wiring from a pipeline target to an interactive widget. Real analyses will pair model inputs with model results on the same page. :::
